text: Tenneco's take-private by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo (NYSE: APO) was announced in February 2022 'in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise valuation of approximately $7.1 billion, including debt,' and completed in November 2022, after which Tenneco's shares stopped trading on the NYSE.

source.name: Apollo Global Management: Tenneco to Be Acquired by Apollo Funds
source.quote: in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise valuation of approximately $7.1 billion, including debt
